---
title: "viromelib — Rank plot (v8, orderedRef)"
output: html_notebook
---

Ranks every stall-positive accession by its strongest site and colours by CM class.

Changes from `rank_plot_v7_7_updated20260615`:

- input is **`*.sites_final.csv`** (the gated publication site set, 391 sites / 286 accessions) instead of
  the raw annotated peak table. The gates are therefore already applied and no filtering happens here.
- `plain_accession` is used directly; v7 regex-extracted it from `accession`.
- labels come from **`organism`** (the GenBank name, e.g. "Tick-borne encephalitis virus"). The `species`
  column is now the ICTV binomial ("Orthoflavivirus encephalitidis") and is unrecognisable.
- **Class 4 added** to the CM scheme (v7 had 1a/1b/2 and 3 only; the annotation set is five CMs).
- `TOP_N_LABELS` optionally labels the strongest N accessions in addition to the hand-picked highlights.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(svglite)
```

## Paths

```{r paths}
INPUT_DIR <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/fig1/inputs/20261019_rerun_viromelib_ordered"
SITES_CSV <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "261019_re-run_viromelib_orderedRef_orderedRef.sites_final.csv")

outdir <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/rank/20261019"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

TOP_N_LABELS <- 0        # set e.g. 10 to also label the strongest N accessions
```

## Highlights and colours

```{r highlights}
highlight_lookup <- tribble(
  ~accession,      ~highlight_name,
  "NC_015843.2",   "Tembusu virus",
  "NC_012532.1",   "Zika virus",
  "NC_024077.1",   "SbCNV-5",
  "NC_034223.1",   "Mogiana tick virus"
)

CM_COLS <- c(
  class1a = "CL_Class_1a_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class1b = "CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class2  = "CL_Class_2_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class3  = "cl3_NAR_2025.align.mpkadded.edited.confident.dedup.IDcurated.SS_cons.cm_hit",
  class4  = "cl4.cm_hit"
)

cm_colors <- c(
  "class1a" = "#B5179E",
  "class1b" = "#7209B7",
  "class2"  = "#3A0CA3",
  "class3"  = "#1B998B",
  "class4"  = "#136F63",
  "no_hit"  = "#CCCCCC"
)
cm_labels <- c(
  "class1a" = "Class 1a", "class1b" = "Class 1b", "class2" = "Class 2",
  "class3"  = "Class 3",  "class4"  = "Class 4",  "no_hit" = "No hit"
)
cm_priority <- c("class1a", "class1b", "class2", "class3", "class4")
```

## Load and collapse to one row per accession

```{r load_data}
sites <- read_csv(SITES_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)

missing_cols <- setdiff(c("plain_accession", "accession", "meta_qvalue"), names(sites))
stopifnot("sites file is missing expected columns" = length(missing_cols) == 0)

pcol <- if ("meta_pvalue" %in% names(sites)) "meta_pvalue" else "meta_qvalue"
message(glue::glue("ranking on {pcol}"))

sites <- sites %>%
  mutate(
    organism = if ("organism" %in% names(.)) organism else NA_character_,
    family   = ifelse(is.na(family) | family %in% c("", "nan"), "Unknown", family),
    pval     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[pcol]])),
    log10p   = -log10(pmax(pval, 1e-300))
  )

# CM class per site, by priority
for (k in names(CM_COLS)) {
  col <- CM_COLS[[k]]
  sites[[paste0("hit_", k)]] <- if (col %in% names(sites)) {
    !is.na(sites[[col]]) & as.character(sites[[col]]) != ""
  } else FALSE
}
sites <- sites %>%
  mutate(cm_class = case_when(
    hit_class1a ~ "class1a", hit_class1b ~ "class1b", hit_class2 ~ "class2",
    hit_class3  ~ "class3",  hit_class4  ~ "class4", TRUE ~ "no_hit"
  ))

# one row per accession: strongest site, and the best CM class seen anywhere on that genome
df_ranked <- sites %>%
  group_by(plain_accession) %>%
  summarise(
    organism     = first(na.omit(organism)),
    species      = if ("species" %in% names(sites)) first(na.omit(species)) else NA_character_,
    family       = first(family),
    n_sites      = n(),
    best_log10p  = max(log10p, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_site_id = if ("site_id" %in% names(sites)) site_id[which.max(log10p)] else NA_character_,
    best_feature = accession[which.max(log10p)],
    cm_class = {
      cls <- cm_class[cm_class != "no_hit"]
      if (length(cls) == 0) "no_hit" else cm_priority[min(match(cls, cm_priority), na.rm = TRUE)]
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(accession = plain_accession) %>%
  left_join(highlight_lookup, by = "accession") %>%
  mutate(label_name = coalesce(highlight_name, organism))

message(glue::glue("{nrow(df_ranked)} accessions | {sum(df_ranked$n_sites)} sites"))
print(table(df_ranked$cm_class))
message(glue::glue("highlights matched: {sum(!is.na(df_ranked$highlight_name))} of {nrow(highlight_lookup)}"))
if (any(is.na(df_ranked$organism)))
  warning(sum(is.na(df_ranked$organism)), " accessions without an organism name — ",
          "re-run apply_publication_cutoffs.py with --snapshot-manifest")
```

## Rank plot

```{r rank_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
n_acc <- nrow(df_ranked)
y_max <- max(df_ranked$best_log10p, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08

df_sorted <- df_ranked %>%
  arrange(desc(best_log10p)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank      = row_number(),
    frac_rank = (rank - 1) / max(n_acc - 1, 1),
    cm_class  = factor(cm_class, levels = names(cm_colors))
  )

label_df <- df_sorted %>%
  filter(!is.na(highlight_name) | (TOP_N_LABELS > 0 & rank <= TOP_N_LABELS)) %>%
  mutate(label_text = paste0(label_name, "\n", accession))

rank_plot <- ggplot(df_sorted, aes(x = frac_rank, y = best_log10p)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(df_sorted, cm_class == "no_hit"),
             colour = cm_colors[["no_hit"]], size = 1.4, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = filter(df_sorted, cm_class != "no_hit"),
             aes(fill = cm_class), shape = 21, size = 2.4, alpha = 0.95, stroke = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, labels = cm_labels, name = "CM class", drop = FALSE) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = label_df, aes(label = label_text),
    colour = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 3.4,
    fill = alpha("white", 0.78), label.size = 0.25,
    label.padding = unit(0.25, "lines"), box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    point.padding = unit(0.4, "lines"), max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0, segment.colour = "grey40", segment.size = 0.4,
    direction = "y", nudge_x = 0.10, hjust = 0, force = 5, seed = 42,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = glue::glue("Rank plot — {n_acc} stall-positive accessions, {sum(df_ranked$n_sites)} sites"),
    subtitle = glue::glue("ordered-reference analysis; ranked on {pcol} of the strongest site per genome"),
    x = "Fractional rank (0 = strongest)",
    y = if (pcol == "meta_pvalue") expression(-log[10](p[meta])) else expression(-log[10](q[meta]))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.02, 1.02), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text          = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position    = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#F0F0F0", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

rank_plot

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "01_rank_plot.pdf"), rank_plot, width = 10, height = 8, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "01_rank_plot.svg"), rank_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
write_csv(df_sorted, file.path(outdir, "rank_table.csv"))
message("-> ", file.path(outdir, "01_rank_plot.pdf"))
```
